newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Hanbo creditors seek POSCO help.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Hanbo creditors seek POSCO help.

text.p: Creditor banks for debt-ridden Hanbo Steel Corp said on Thursday it would ask Pohang Iron and Steel Co (POSCO) to complete a Hanbo steel mill now under construction in the southeastern city of Tangjin.
They would also file for a court receivership order for Hanbo and seek a buyer to take over the mill after completion.
Hanbo, a steel bar and hot coil maker, defaulted on payments of an unspecified amount of promissory notes on Thursday, the state-run Korea Financial Telecommunications and Clearings Institute said.
Local media reports said Hanbo failed to pay 1.5 billion won ($1.8 million) to Boram Bank to honour maturing notes.
Hanbo's debt totalled about 5.7 trillion won, Hanbo Steel officials said.
Hanbo's financial problems stem from the construction of the Tangjin mill, industry analysts said.
